name: Google Gemini
question: What is Gemini AI?
title: What is Google Gemini? | BrandBizkit
description:
Understanding the basics of Google Gemini AI. What it is, what it can do, and how it works.
Explore the revolutionary AI technology that's transforming how we interact with machines and access information
paragraphs: Gemini is Google's most advanced AI model, designed from the ground up to be multimodal. This means it can seamlessly understand, operate across, and combine different types of information including text, images, audio, video, and code.

Developed by Google DeepMind, Gemini represents a significant leap forward in AI capabilities. It's not just an upgrade but a fundamental rethinking of how AI models should be built to better understand and interact with the world in a way that's more similar to how humans do.

Gemini comes in three sizes—Ultra, Pro, and Nano—each optimized for different tasks and computational requirements, making it versatile enough to run on everything from data centers to mobile devices.

capabilities.heading: What Can Gemini Do?
capabilities.sub: A quick look at what's actually in the Gemini app today — this gets re-checked regularly as Google ships updates.

items.title: Multimodal Understanding
items.text: Understands and combines text, images, audio, video and code in one conversation — describe a problem however is easiest, in whatever format you have.

items.title: Deep Research
items.text: Hand it a question and it browses the web autonomously across multiple steps, coming back with a cited, structured report instead of a single answer.

items.title: Built-in Image Generation
items.text: Generate and edit images inline with Google's Nano Banana model, right inside the same chat.

items.title: Live Voice Conversations
items.text: Real-time, natural spoken conversations through Gemini Live — including sharing your screen or camera as you talk.

items.title: Custom Gems
items.text: Build a reusable personal assistant tuned to one specific job — a brand voice editor, a research assistant, a coding tutor — without starting from scratch each time.

items.title: Massive Context Window
items.text: Handles up to 2 million tokens in a single conversation, enough to reason over an entire codebase, book, or set of long documents at once.
